audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[4..6].side all read "Cassiopeia" while content win[4..6] and the packet levelChart read "Anivia". The full-layer whys for those same rows already describe Anivia taking over (Glacial Storm, Seraph's, teamfight wall), so the side token contradicts its own why as well as the other layer.
audit.why: Anivia's 52.7% over 463 games and the packet chart both put rows 4-6 on Anivia once Glacial Storm is online.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side = Anivia, matching win[4..6] and the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is written as "Petrify roots you" and the mid breakdown calls it a "fear-into-combo".
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is neither a root nor a fear: it stuns enemies facing Cassiopeia and only slows enemies whose backs are turned, on a 120/100/80s cooldown. Turning away is the counterplay, and the page never says so.
audit.corrected: Spike and mid text now state the facing rule and the 120s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d sell Miasma as "dashes and leaps are disabled inside it" — Anivia has no dash or leap, so the stated interaction does not apply to this matchup at all. Meanwhile the real ones are absent: Twin Fang heals on a 0.75s cooldown and hits harder on poisoned targets, Cassiopeia has no dash in her kit, and the range ladder (Flash Frost 1075 vs Noxious Blast 850 vs Twin Fang 700) decides every trade.
audit.why: Miasma matters here for its slow on an immobile champion and for its 24/22/20/18/16s cooldown, not for grounding. Crystallize is a genuine cage against a dashless enemy, and Glacial Storm's 750 zone overlaps Twin Fang's 700 range, so she cannot use E without standing in the storm.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns, enemyWin, ahead, breakdown.carry, the do/don't details and spikes[3] around ranges, cooldowns and the no-dash fact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is mentioned only in report[8]; the lane advice never tells you when it matters.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags Twin Fang sustain as deciding extended trades — it heals a percentage of damage dealt on a 0.75s cooldown, so chip poke into a full health bar is net negative for you.
audit.corrected: ahead and dontsFull[0].d now carry the Grievous Wounds and Twin Fang sustain point.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Check it before every step-up. - W Crystallize is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and her only lock on an immobile bird — once the cloud is spent you have a twenty-second window to step up and stun. - Crystallize is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins by landing Miasma, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins by chaining poison into Twin Fang, healing through your chip, and out-walking you to every wave.

edits.before: Ahead, the lane is a prison: storm every wave, wall Cassiopeia away from the comeback farm, and rotate first to every river fight with your stun loaded.
edits.after: Ahead, deny her the poison rhythm: storm every wave, wall her off the catch-up farm, and buy anti-heal before Twin Fang chips you back into her range.

edits.before: Carry by controlling space — storm and wall decide where fights happen, and your stun decides who dies first inside them.
edits.after: Carry by holding the 750 storm over the objective — Cassiopeia must stand at 700 to Twin Fang anything, and that is inside your zone.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Flash Frost reaches 1075; Noxious Blast is 850 and Twin Fang 700 — throw from the edge and bank the mana back.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Cassiopeia burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Glacial Storm clears the wave instantly and covers 750 — she cannot Twin Fang you from inside it without eating the zone and a double-damage Frostbite.

edits.before: Cassiopeia spends Miasma early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Crystallize behind her and she has no dash to cross it — she walks, and Miasma is 24s away.

edits.before: That’s Cassiopeia’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Twin Fang heals her on a 0.75s cooldown — chip poke into a full bar just feeds the sustain.

edits.before: Your wall is your Flash — a wasted Crystallize means the next gank kills the bird AND the egg.
edits.after: Noxious Blast poison makes every Twin Fang hit harder and heal her — never last-hit inside the cloud.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Cassiopeia walks straight at you.
edits.after: She moves faster than you off every Noxious Blast — past river with no egg there is no version of the walk home that works.

edits.before: Cassiopeia: Petrify fear-into-combo still threatens a full kill even after Anivia's ult comes online.
edits.after: Cassiopeia: Petrifying Gaze stuns you if you face her, and the combo behind it still threatens a kill.

edits.before: Anivia: wall completely denies Cassiopeia's only engage tool, giving Anivia a free burst window.
edits.after: Anivia: with no dash in her kit, Cassiopeia cannot cross Crystallize to reach Twin Fang range.

edits.before: Petrify roots you into a full combo — the fear factor still outweighs your fresh Glacial Storm at this stage.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only if you face her — turn and you take a slow, but a 120s ult still beats your fresh storm.

edits.before: Your wall blocks her ground-based Twin Fang engage entirely, letting your Storm+combo burst her down before she gets in range.
edits.after: She has no dash, so Crystallize simply removes her from Twin Fang's 700 range while your storm and Frostbite finish her.

edits.before: Cassiopeia's damage and mobility edge continues through level 5 — she out-scales your farming lane with poison ticks and can flee any poke you land. At level 6 her Petrify still threatens a full fear-into-combo kill even though your Glacial Storm is now online, since she can bait your R and disengage before it matters. Watch for her all-in the moment she lands Petrify; that's her single biggest kill window and it beats your early-6 damage.
edits.after: Cassiopeia's damage and mobility edge continues through level 5 — she out-scales your farming lane with poison ticks and can flee any poke you land. At level 6 Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her, so turning as she casts converts the stun into a slow you can walk out of. Watch for her all-in the moment it lands; that is her biggest kill window, and at rank 1 it is 120 seconds before the next one.

notes: Level chart: win[4..6] already read "Anivia" on disk, so only the three full-layer side tokens are proposed; after the write both layers agree.
